children: Dine Brands Global declared a $0.19 per share cash dividend for Q3 2026.
Board declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.19 per common share.
Dividend payable on October 9, 2026 to holders of record as of Sept. 16, 2026.
Announcement disclosed via press release filed as Exhibit 99.1 to the Form 8-K.
Press release reiterates company operates Applebee’s, IHOP and Fuzzy’s Taco Shop brands (~3,500 restaurants).
